title: Creating Steering Vectors via Input Optimisation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17481v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering influences a language model's behaviour by adding a steering vector to its residual stream during generation, but it requires white-box access to modify the hidden states at every generation step. We introduce ActGCG, a modification of Greedy Coordinate Gradient which optimises a suffix to match the target activations obtained by adding a steering vector to the residual stream. We further introduce universal suffixes trained across many prompts at once, a model-translation step that rewrites the suffix into human-readable text midway through optimisation, and a soft-suffix variant to remove the discrete token space constraint. We study two behaviours: steering a model to answer in German, and anti-refusal steering for jailbreaking. translated_title: 通过输入优化创建引导向量
translated_abstract: 激活引导通过在生成过程中向语言模型的残差流添加引导向量来影响模型行为，但这种方法需要对模型的白盒访问权限，以便在每个生成步骤中修改隐藏状态。我们提出了ActGCG，这是对贪婪坐标梯度方法的一种改进，它通过优化一个后缀来匹配将引导向量添加到残差流后所获得的目标激活。我们进一步引入了同时在多个提示上训练的通用后缀、一个在优化过程中将后缀改写为人类可读文本的模型翻译步骤，以及一种去除离散词元空间约束的软后缀变体。我们研究了两种行为：引导模型用德语回答，以及用于越狱攻击的反拒绝引导。对于德语引导，离散后缀几乎完美地复现了引导向量的行为，并且在提示和模型之间具有良好的迁移性。对于反拒绝引导，这种等效性较弱。
tldr: 本文提出ActGCG方法，通过优化输入后缀来模拟激活引导向量的效果，使攻击者无需白盒访问模型内部状态，即可通过修改输入文本实现与激活引导相同的行为操控，包括语言切换和越狱攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ActGCG, a method that optimizes input suffixes to emulate the effects of activation steering vectors, enabling behavior control of language models—including language switching and jailbreaking—through input manipulation alone, without requiring white-box access to internal states.
